premise: Gallimimus leaps over the mud puddle — whee — and over the log, nearly — whoosh — and wants to jump the big leaf too; it's far too tall, so she ducks under it instead, then races back for one last enormous jump and lands SPLOSH in the middle of the puddle.
inspiration: The folk-tale boast of the high jumper (the frog who would leap the moon) undone gently: the last jump is the funniest one.
lesson: Laugh when things don't go to plan.

en-US.title: Gallimimus Jumps Everything
en-US.text: {puddle:enter} {log:enter} {leaf:enter} {gallimimus:enter} Gallimimus had long, springy legs, and today she wanted to jump over EVERYTHING. {gallimimus:face happy} {gallimimus:live ready-set hold} "Ready, steady," {gallimimus:live ready-set resume} "GO!" {gallimimus:go to puddle} First, the mud puddle. {gallimimus:live jump} {sfx:whee} WHEE! Right over it. {gallimimus:go to log} Next, the log. {gallimimus:hop} WHOOSH! Over it, or nearly. Her toe tapped the top, {log:live bump} bump, and the old log jolted. [giggles] Still over! Then she saw the big leaf. {gallimimus:face surprised} It was tall. Very tall. Much too tall to jump. "Hmm." {gallimimus:go under leaf} So she ducked her head and ran right under it instead. {gallimimus:face happy} [laughs] "Under counts too!" Back she raced, {gallimimus:go to puddle} all the way to the mud puddle, ready for one last, enormous jump. One, two, THREE! {puddle:live splash} {sfx:splosh} SPLOSH! Right in the middle. {gallimimus:face surprised} Mud on her toes. Mud on her tail. Mud on the tip of her beak. {gallimimus:face happy} {gallimimus:live laugh} Gallimimus laughed and laughed. [happily] "Over, over, under," she said, "and IN! That's the best jump of all."

es-ES.title: Gallimimus lo salta todo
es-ES.text: {puddle:enter} {log:enter} {leaf:enter} {gallimimus:enter} Gallimimus tenía unas patas largas y saltarinas, y hoy quería saltarlo TODO. {gallimimus:face happy} {gallimimus:live ready-set hold} —Preparados, listos… {gallimimus:live ready-set resume} ¡YA! {gallimimus:go to puddle} Primero, el charco de barro. {gallimimus:live jump} {sfx:whee} ¡HOPA! Por encima. {gallimimus:go to log} Después, el tronco. {gallimimus:hop} ¡FIUUU! Por encima, o casi. Lo rozó con la punta del pie, {log:live bump} toc, y el viejo tronco dio un respingo. [giggles] ¡Pero lo saltó! Entonces vio la hoja grande. {gallimimus:face surprised} Era alta. Muy alta. Demasiado alta para saltarla. —Mmm. {gallimimus:go under leaf} Así que agachó la cabeza y pasó corriendo por debajo. {gallimimus:face happy} [laughs] —¡Por debajo también vale! Y volvió a toda carrera {gallimimus:go to puddle} hasta el charco de barro, lista para un último salto enorme. ¡Una, dos y TRES! {puddle:live splash} {sfx:splosh} ¡CHOF! Justo en medio. {gallimimus:face surprised} Barro en las patas. Barro en la cola. Barro en la punta del pico. {gallimimus:face happy} {gallimimus:live laugh} Gallimimus se partía de risa. [happily] —Por encima, por encima, por debajo… ¡y DENTRO! El mejor salto de todos.

whee.prompt: a quick springy comic boing of a big jump through the air, playful

splosh.prompt: landing feet first in a thick mud puddle, a big wet splosh and splatter, realistic
